note: Prairie County AR publishes no county zoning layer; the county has no zoning map service found in ArcGIS Hub/Online or web searches. The only city zoning found is Hazen's: its Title 14 zoning ordinance (PDF) lists districts and says the Zoning District Map is kept at City Hall, with no queryable polygon service. Des Arc and DeValls Bluff show no zoning publication. Zoning exists only as PDF text and a paper/city-hall map, so not queryable.
